title: 第20章 人面雾鼍第21章 斩妖
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 人面雾鼍？
江霸脸色一变，“雾妖不是晚上才会现身吗，可现在还没到晚上啊。”
谁能想到，镇妖司的大人还没等来，却先等来了雾妖！
赵河山惊惧道：“它果然更强了，不用等到晚上也会出来。”
江浩等一众年轻人亦是脸色煞白，这人面雾鼍带着如墨般的黑夜前来，他们连方位都看不清，只能被这哭声一遍又一遍的璀璨的心理防线。
那哭声越来越大，逐渐变得凄厉，直到某一刻，一股寒意直冲心头，江霸终于看到一大团犹如黑潮一般的雾气压到了江家堡百丈范围内。
“放火油！”
来不及多想，他大喝一声，顿时便见几个合抱粗的的木桶被抛到前方的半空之中。
江霸抓起一把大弓，嗖的射出一支火箭。
嘭的一声，木桶被精准射爆。
在绚烂的火光中，周围大片场景被照亮，一双犹如窗户一般大小的幽绿竖瞳出现在了众人面前。
那幽绿竖瞳隐在黑潮之中，转瞬便又消失不见。
一股恶臭无比的腥风吹起，火光便瞬间熄灭了七七八八。
“它果然又成长了！”
赵河山望见了那一双幽绿竖瞳，他惊惧起来，又夹杂着深深的绝望：“这人面雾鼍第二次袭击我赵家堡的时候，它就躲在黑雾里，我们拿它没有一点办法。”
“再放火油！”
江霸再次大吼，便是搭弓再射。
这次投放的火油更多，火光将整座城楼都照的透亮。
层层火幕落入黑雾之中，一个足有城墙高的巨大轮廓出现在了众人面前。
那巨鼍伏在地上，全身覆盖着脸盆大小的鳞片，而在那鳞片上，长着一张张紧闭双眼的狰狞人脸，几人听到的哭声，正是来自于此。
一簇簇人发从鳞片间的缝隙中长出来，以脊背为线，垂落两边。
漆黑的夜色下，从正面远远看过去，这巨鼍就像是一个硕大的人头！
“好恶心的畜生。”
已经见过一次的赵河山等人还好，但初次见到这人面雾鼍的江霸等人一阵头皮发麻。
那巨鼍被照出身形，顿时舞动四肢向江家堡疾冲而来。
长发在黑雾中乱舞，巨鼍张开镶嵌满利齿的大口，活像一个人在狞笑。
人头下，它的左前肢尤其令人注意，因为这是一只完全由人手与人腿组成的肉腿，巨鼍带着腥风冲过来，极具压迫之感，饶是江霸，一时也忍不住后退了几步。
赵河山还记得当初见到这巨鼍的场景，彼时对方从漆黑的水域浮出，他站在赵家堡的城墙上，远远看去，好似一个巨大的女子将头颅探出水在对着他笑。
江浩哪里见过这种场景，他脸色苍白，声音都在颤抖：“爹，爹，我们怎么办？”
“都振作点。”
江霸虽也惊惧万分，但他知道，自己身为堡主，这种时候一定不能自乱阵脚，他大喝一声：“老七、老八，守住城墙，放箭支援。”
“老二、老三你们几个随我出城迎敌，只要拦下它，守到镇妖司的大人到来我们就有希望。”
他说罢，身后顿时走出了四名壮汉。
砰砰砰砰！
五道结结实实的落地声响起。
只见江霸五人此刻已是提刀径直从城墙上跳了下去。
“老二、老三，你们从左侧牵制，老四、老六，你们两个从右侧。”
江霸一声令下，四人齐齐动了。
content_en:
A foggy face?
Jiang Ba's expression changed, "Don't the mist monsters only show up at night? But it's not night yet."
Who would have thought that before the Lord of the Demon Suppression Department arrived, the Mist Demon arrived first!
Zhao Heshan said in horror: "It is indeed stronger. It will come out without waiting until night."
Jiang Hao and other young people also had pale faces. This man came with a foggy face in the ink-like darkness. They couldn't even see the direction clearly, and could only be protected by the bright psychological defense of the cry over and over again.
The crying became louder and louder, and gradually became more and more sad, until at a certain moment, a chill hit his heart, and Jiang Ba finally saw a large mass of fog like a black tide pressing within a hundred feet of Jiangjiabao.
"Put on fire oil!"
Without any time to think about it, he shouted loudly, and immediately saw several barrels as thick as each other being thrown into the air in front of him.
Jiang Ba grabbed a big bow and shot out a rocket.
With a bang, the barrel was accurately shot.
In the gorgeous firelight, a large area of ​​the surrounding scene was illuminated, and a pair of green vertical pupils as big as a window appeared in front of everyone.
The green vertical pupils were hidden in the black tide, and disappeared in an instant.
An extremely foul-smelling wind blew up, and the fire was instantly extinguished.
"It has indeed grown again!"
When Zhao Heshan saw the pair of green vertical pupils, he became frightened, mixed with deep despair: "When this fog-faced man attacked my Zhaojia Fort for the second time, it hid in the black mist, and we had no way to deal with it."
"Put on more kerosene!"
Jiang Ba roared again, then took the bow and shot again.
This time more kerosene was put in, and the firelight illuminated the entire tower.
Layers of fire curtains fell into the black mist, and a huge silhouette as high as a city wall appeared in front of everyone.
The giant cat was lying on the ground, its whole body covered with scales the size of a washbasin, and on the scales, there was a ferocious face with eyes tightly closed. The cry that the few people heard came from this.
Tufts of human hair grew out from the gaps between the scales, taking the back as a line and hanging down on both sides.
Under the dark night, when viewed from a distance from the front, this giant cat looks like a huge human head!
"What a disgusting beast."
Zhao Heshan and others, who had met him once, were fine, but Jiang Ba and others, who had met this man for the first time, felt their scalps numb.
The giant cat's figure was revealed, and it immediately danced its limbs and rushed toward Jiangjiabao.
The long hair danced wildly in the black mist, and the giant turtle opened its mouth studded with sharp teeth, like a man grinning ferociously.
Under the human head, its left forelimb is particularly noticeable, because it is a fleshy leg made entirely of human hands and legs. The giant cat rushed towards it with a fishy wind, which was extremely oppressive. Even Jiang Ba couldn't help but take a few steps back.
Zhao Heshan still remembers the scene when he first saw this giant turtle. At that time, it emerged from the dark waters. He stood on the wall of Zhaojiabao. From a distance, it looked like a huge woman was sticking her head out of the water and smiling at him.
Jiang Hao had never seen such a scene before. His face was pale and his voice was trembling: "Dad, dad, what should we do?"
"Everyone cheer up."
Although Jiang Ba was also frightened, he knew that as the castle lord, he must not lose control of his position at this time. He shouted: "Old Seventh, Old Eighth, guard the city wall and shoot arrows to support."
"Second and Third, you two will follow me out of the city to meet the enemy. As long as we stop it and wait until the adults from the Demon Suppression Division arrive, we will have hope."
After he said that, four strong men suddenly walked out from behind him.
Bang bang bang bang!
Five solid landing sounds were heard.
At this moment, Jiang Ba and the other five men were seen jumping straight off the city wall with their swords in hand.
"Second and third, you control from the left. Fourth and sixth, you two control from the right."
Jiang Ba gave an order and the four of them moved together.
